question: What is the highest-gain reversible extension while the organizer has not specified real-time paper evaluation versus historical replay?
assumptions: The authenticated live hub identifies Options Alpha Agents but does not yet expose a detailed track brief.
The participant Discord contains no official organizer answer about the evaluation window or dataset.
A competition-ready agent may need either current Alpaca paper observations, a specified historical options window, or both.
Broker authentication, order submission, deployment, publication, and form submission remain separately gated.
Alpaca's official current documentation is authoritative for the pre-kickoff read-only API contract.
options: add a synthetic options replay only
add a structurally read-only Alpaca observer plus a manifest-bound replay boundary

evidence.source: authenticated lablab live dashboard and participant Discord
facts: Options Alpha Agents is the only displayed track
no official evaluation-window answer is visible
the free indicative feed is delayed or modified and must be labeled separately from OPRA
Alpaca offers historical options data only from February 2024 onward
indicative and subscribed OPRA evidence must not be conflated
the options engine is C1 on frozen synthetic inputs
zero broker requests and zero external model calls were made

decision: Add a named-method, GET-only Alpaca paper observer that cannot express an order mutation, plus a frozen-manifest options replay whose input digest, controls, and claim ceiling fail closed on tampering. Expose both as evaluation readiness, not as official evaluation or alpha evidence.
claim_ceiling: C1 mechanics until an organizer-approved historical dataset or prospective paper window is frozen and independently evaluated
falsifiers: Any public client method can issue POST, PATCH, PUT, or DELETE.
Any non-paper trading host or non-Alpaca data host is accepted.
Credentials, account ID, or raw secret headers appear in a receipt, dashboard, log, or repository file.
A changed replay observation passes the original manifest digest.
Two runs on the same frozen replay inputs produce different decision metrics.
The new path is described as official evaluation, profitability, or market evidence.
stop_rule: Stop when the read-only observer, redacted reconciliation receipt, manifest-bound replay, named controls, dashboard readiness view, and full verifier pass. Defer real credentials, external data, tuning, publication, deployment, recording, and submission to their explicit active-phase gates.
